summary: A pricing section: plans with a monthly / yearly switch, a feature comparison and an FAQ.
intent: Block: a whole pricing section. A heading and lead, PricingPlans (its Monthly / Yearly switch drives every price), a feature comparison Table across the plans, and an FAQ Accordion. The recommended plan's CTA is the one solid primary.
useWhen: a public pricing page or the pricing section of a landing page
plans need a feature-by-feature comparison and common questions beside them
an upgrade screen that should answer billing questions in place
doNotUseWhen: only the plan cards, e.g. a small upgrade dialog — PricingPlans
usage against a plan limit — UsageMeter or UsageList
picking options in a form — TileGroup
invoices and the billing schedule — the billing-schedule pattern

plans.note: PricingPlans plans: { id, name, tagline?, price, yearlyPrice?, features, ctaLabel?, recommended?, current? }[]. Mark one recommended: its CTA is the one solid primary.

onIntervalChange.note: (interval) => void. The Monthly / Yearly switch changed.

onChoosePlan.note: (planId, interval) => void. A plan's CTA was pressed.

comparison.note: { feature, values: Record<planId, boolean | string> }[]. true reads Included, false or missing Not included, a string as written. Omit to leave the comparison out.

faqs.note: { id, question, answer }[]. Shown as an Accordion when there are two or more.

savingsLabel.note: Passed to PricingPlans, beside the switch.

footnote.note: Passed to PricingPlans, under the cards.

layout: one column: heading and lead, PricingPlans, the comparison, the FAQ
PricingPlans' cards wrap to one per row in a narrow block; the comparison Table keeps its column widths and scrolls inside its own focusable region
the block is its own inline-size container, so it works the same in a page column or full width

requirements: section aria-labelledby the h2 title; place it inside the page's <main>
PricingPlans is a section under its h3, each plan name an h4; the comparison and the FAQ are sections labelled by their h3
the interval is the PricingPlans SegmentedControl radio group named Billing interval
comparison cells say Included or Not included in words for screen readers; the check and dash icons are hidden
the recommended plan's column header says (recommended) in words
FAQ headers are Accordion buttons with aria-expanded and aria-controls
no motion of its own; prices roll with NumberTransition, which honours reduced motion

doNot: Do not rebuild Plans from local plan cards or a pricing table; import the block
Do not show more than one solid primary; only the recommended plan's CTA is solid
Do not add a second Monthly / Yearly switch; the PricingPlans one drives the whole block
Do not mark included features by colour alone
snippet: <Plans title="Pricing" description="Start free, upgrade when your team grows." plans={plans} comparison={comparison} faqs={faqs} savingsLabel="Save 20% with yearly" onChoosePlan={(id, interval) => checkout(id, interval)} />
